name: gates-keep-the-line
scope:
Owns three operations of IMPLICIT_SPEC.md, 'Operations': O1, "A thing arrives and is decided", whole, for both gates; O2, "The layer's setting is written", as a rule of a gate: S1 to S5, with its paragraphs on latency, throughput, data growth, concurrency and edge cases as they bear on a gate (what the setting does to the read, S6 to S9 and R13, goes with O3 to the next stage); and O6, "A second run of the gates over the depots", A1 to A10. Also the 'door' lines of every row of IMPLICIT_SPEC.md 'Entity State × Write Matrix'.

The state to figure out is "Whatever a gate comes to keep for this read" (SPEC.md, 'What must hold', 1), on both gates: the interface that the two later stages read. It is bound by SPEC.md 'What must hold' 1 to 6 and by IMPLICIT_SPEC.md W1 to W7 and A1 to A9. It must make achievable, for the later stages: SPEC.md 'The read' ("the arrival that was decided"; "Bounded, by count and by bytes"; "It says what it left out"; "A stray is not in it"); SPEC.md 'Who may read what' ("The who of a refused thing is read from the raw thing"; "An asker is given her own things in any layer"); IMPLICIT_SPEC.md R7, R9, R10, R14, R15, R16 and L1; and the read kept live that the last stage weighs (SPEC.md, "Whether the read can also be kept live"; IMPLICIT_SPEC.md O5). The first two bullets of SPEC.md 'What Phase 1 has to weigh, and is not told' are this stage's to weigh; IMPLICIT_SPEC.md Q4 and Q7 bear on them. IMPLICIT_SPEC.md A9, the decisions from before the build, is said here.

The other state this stage writes for the next one is the setting's row (SPEC.md, 'The setting'). SPEC.md calls its key "A sixth key of the store"; piece 2 has since added two store keys (`door/declaration.clj`, `store-keys`), so it is the eighth. IMPLICIT_SPEC.md O2's "Phase 1 confirms each against the code that it changes" is held against the code as piece 2 left it (`gate/decision.clj`; `gate/chain.clj`, `place`).

Cost: SPEC.md 'What must hold' 8, "What each decision costs more, in reads and writes, for both gates" and "what the store keeps twice", beside `module/walk.clj`, 'What one call costs'. What must come out unchanged: IMPLICIT_SPEC.md 'What exists and must come out unchanged', its bullets on the door's read by act-id, the strays, and the cost of a decision. Proofs: SPEC.md 'Proofs', the bullets "the module on the in-process cluster, both gates" and "the run-again proof", with IMPLICIT_SPEC.md A6 to A8; and the pages of SPEC.md 'Pages that change with it' that this stage's code changes.

name: read-the-line-by-stamp
scope:
Owns two operations of IMPLICIT_SPEC.md, 'Operations': O3, "The read: a layer's decisions by stamp, asked once", and O4, "The layer's last stamp, asked with the read", whole, for both gates and for every asker of O3's table. With them: what the setting does to this read (IMPLICIT_SPEC.md S6 to S9, R13); and the 'range', 'last' and 'facts' lines of every row of IMPLICIT_SPEC.md 'Entity State × Write Matrix'. It builds on the state that the first stage keeps and on the setting's row that it writes.

Where the two pages differ. SPEC.md "An asker is given her own things in any layer" is the resolution of IMPLICIT_SPEC.md Q1. It governs IMPLICIT_SPEC.md wherever that page follows the earlier reading: O3's table, the row of a layer that she may not see; the rows of E1, E4 and E5 that leave an asker's own things out of a layer that she may not see; and R10, which counts stamps for an asker who may see the layer.

Q2, Q3 and Q6 of IMPLICIT_SPEC.md are taken at their defaults, built, and each marked in the plan as a session's choice for Sid to turn. Q2: as IMPLICIT_SPEC.md Q2 has it, "the read of a layer gives the line of the layer's own gate and never mixes the two". Q3: by SPEC.md "An asker is given her own things in any layer", which then governs O3's table, the row of a layer that is not made, and E1's rows of a refused thing under a layer id that is not made. Q6: as SPEC.md 'The setting' writes it, "With `:everyone`, whoever may see the layer reads its acts whole". Q4, Q5, Q8 and Q9 bear on this stage and are settled or said here.

SPEC.md 'Who may read what' names "A permission that stands" by `permission-state` alone. Since piece 2, a read sees a layer under the asker's permission for the layer or under her run's (`read_path/layers.clj`, `either`, `run-permission-state`), and a permission sits on what it covers (`gate/chain.clj`, `place`). This stage says what a holder is for this read, and marks that as a session's choice.

The state to figure out: what the read path opens and calls for this read beside what it holds today (SPEC.md 'What Phase 1 has to weigh, and is not told', the third bullet); the numbers of SPEC.md "Bounded, by count and by bytes", "beside the read path's others"; the task on which each source of a read of the base is read, and why (SPEC.md 'What must hold' 5; IMPLICIT_SPEC.md R14); and the rule of who may read what, in the one place of IMPLICIT_SPEC.md R18, by which the last stage's live read also reads. It is bound by SPEC.md 'The read', 'Who may read what' and 'What must hold' 4 to 7; by IMPLICIT_SPEC.md O3 and O4 whole, R1 to R20 among them; by IMPLICIT_SPEC.md 'Where SPEC.md and the code differ', its bullets on `max-act-bytes`, on how a read of facts reads her permission, and on the form of the answer; and by IMPLICIT_SPEC.md A5 for whatever it adds to the module.

Cost: SPEC.md 'What must hold' 8, "what one read of n decisions costs, in seeks and in round trips", with IMPLICIT_SPEC.md O3's 'Throughput' and 'Concurrency', and R16. What must come out unchanged: IMPLICIT_SPEC.md 'What exists and must come out unchanged', every read of facts, and "the rule that under `:everyone` a read of facts reads no permission". Proofs: SPEC.md 'Proofs', the bullets "pure ones, with no cluster" and "the read path on the cluster"; and the pages of SPEC.md 'Pages that change with it', with the last bullet of IMPLICIT_SPEC.md 'What exists and must come out unchanged'.

name: read-the-line-live
scope:
Owns IMPLICIT_SPEC.md O5, "The same read kept live (only if Phase 1 offers it)", and the 'live' lines of every row of IMPLICIT_SPEC.md 'Entity State × Write Matrix'. It weighs and says what SPEC.md 'The read' leaves to Phase 1 in its paragraph "Whether the read can also be kept live", and builds on the first stage's kept state and the second stage's read.

If it offers the read kept live, it is bound by IMPLICIT_SPEC.md V1 to V5 and by SPEC.md 'What must hold' 7, "a read that is kept live leaves the layer when her permission ends, or one above it". It reads by the rule of who may read what that the second stage built, with that stage's choices on Q2, Q3, Q6 and on what a holder is. If it does not offer it, it says what O5's first paragraph asks: "how a caller learns of new decisions (the poll of O3) and what that costs".

The state to figure out: whatever a live read of a layer's line holds or opens beyond what the first two stages made, and what it takes of the bounds that IMPLICIT_SPEC.md V4 names. Whatever it comes to have a gate keep is held to O6 (IMPLICIT_SPEC.md A1 to A8; SPEC.md 'What must hold' 1 to 3), which the first stage owns. Cost: SPEC.md 'What must hold' 8, as it bears on a read kept live. Proofs: SPEC.md 'Proofs', "the read path on the cluster", as it reaches a read kept live; and the pages of SPEC.md 'Pages that change with it' that this stage's code changes.
